points: Chop the potatoes into 2cm chunks (peel first if you prefer).
Pour the boiling water into a large saucepan with 1/2 tsp salt.
Add the potatoes to the water and cook until you can easily slip a knife through, 15-18 mins.
steps.title: Cook the Potatoes

points: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of oil in a frying pan on medium-high heat.
Once hot, add the diced chicken to the pan and season with salt and pepper.
Cook until browned all over, 5-6 mins. Turn occasionally.
Peel and grate the garlic (or use a garlic press).

notes.text: Wash your hands and equipment after handling raw chicken and its packaging.

steps.title: Time to Fry

points: Once the chicken has browned, add the garlic and Cajun spice mix (add less if you'd prefer things milder). Stir-fry for 1 min.
Stir in the passata, chicken stock paste and sugar (see pantry for amount). Bring to the boil, then lower the heat and simmer.
Cook until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened, 3-4 mins.

notes.text: The chicken is cooked when no longer pink in the middle.

steps.title: Add the Flavour

points: Once the sauce has thickened and the chicken is cooked, stir through the creme fraiche and hard Italian style cheese.
Add the spinach to the pan a handful at a time until wilted, 1-2 mins.
steps.title: Wilt the Spinach

points: Meanwhile, once the potatoes are cooked, drain in a colander and return to the pan, off the heat.
Add a knob of butter and a splash of milk (if you have any) and mash until smooth.
steps.title: Mash the Potatoes

points: When everything's ready, spoon the creamy tomato Cajun chicken into your bowls.
steps.title: Serve
